    gc-card-in 0.9s var(--ease-out) 1.25s both,
    gc-float 9.5s var(--ease-in-out) 2.15s infinite;
}

.hv__card-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 2.6em;
  height: 2.6em;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 0.6em;
  background: var(--c-ink-950);
  color: var(--c-lime);
}

.hv__card-icon .icon {
  width: 1.35em;
  height: 1.35em;
}

.hv__card-icon--ai {
  position: relative;
  width: 2.1em;
  height: 2.1em;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-green), var(--c-ink-900));
  color: var(--c-white);
}

.hv__card-icon--ai::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -3px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgb(25 197 139 / 0.6);
  animation: gc-ping 2.6s var(--ease-out) 2s infinite;
}

.hv__card-icon--ai .icon {
  width: 1.1em;
  height: 1.1em;
  animation: gc-twinkle 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.hv__card-text {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.15em;
  line-height: 1.5;
  min-width: 0;
}

.hv__card-text strong {
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.hv__card-text span {
  font-size: 0.82em;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.hv__toggle {
  position: relative;
  margin-inline-start: auto;
  width: 2.7em;
  height: 1.5em;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 1em;
  background: var(--c-lime);
  box-shadow: 0 0 1.2em -0.1em rgb(163 244 81 / 0.8);
}

.hv__toggle-knob {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.18em;
  right: 0.18em;
  width: 1.14em;
  height: 1.14em;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-ink-950);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25);
  transform: translateX(-1.2em);
}

.js .hv__toggle {
  animation: hv-toggle-track 0.4s var(--ease-out) 2s both;
}

.js .hv__toggle-knob {
  animation: hv-toggle-knob 0.4s var(--ease-spring) 2s both;
}

.hv__ai-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5em;
  font-size: 0.92em;
}

.hv__ai-head strong {
  font-weight: 800;
}

.hv__online {
  margin-inline-start: auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35em;
  font-size: 0.78em;
  color: var(--c-green-ink);
}

.hv__online::before {
  content: '';
  width: 0.5em;
  height: 0.5em;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-green);
  animation: gc-breathe 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.hv__bubble {
  display: grid;
  padding: 0.6em 0.8em;
  border-radius: 0.7em 0.2em 0.7em 0.7em;
  background: var(--c-white);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-line);
  font-size: 0.88em;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* assistant messages cycle in the same grid cell (height never jumps) */
.hv__msg {
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
}

.hv__msg:not(:first-child) {
  visibility: hidden;
}

.js .hv__msg {
  visibility: visible;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: hv-msg 12s var(--ease-out) infinite both;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--m, 0) * 4s + 1.9s);
}

.hv__typing {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 0.3em;
  padding-inline: 0.4em;
}

.hv__typing i {
  width: 0.42em;
  height: 0.42em;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-green);
  animation: gc-typing 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.hv__typing i:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.15s;
}

.hv__typing i:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.3s;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   2. PRODUCTS
   ========================================================================== */

.products__grid {
  --gap: clamp(1rem, 1.6vw, 1.5rem);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--gap);
  margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
}

.products__item {
  grid-column: span 12;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
}

.products__item > * {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1023.98px) {
  .products__item:not(.products__item--featured) {
    grid-column: span 6;
  }

  .products__item:not(.products__item--featured):nth-child(even):last-child {
    grid-column: span 12;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .products__item--featured {
    grid-column: span 8;
    grid-row: span 2;
  }

  .products__item:not(.products__item--featured) {
    grid-column: span 4;
  }

  .products__item--featured + .products__item:last-child {
    grid-row: span 2;
  }

  .products__item:nth-child(3n + 4):last-child {
    grid-column: span 12;
  }

  .products__item:nth-child(3n + 5):last-child,
  .products__item:nth-child(3n + 4):nth-last-child(2) {
    grid-column: span 6;
  }
}

.products__footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
}

/* ---- Product card ---- */
.p-card {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  container-type: inline-size;
  display: flex;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: var(--c-white);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-line);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  translate: 0 0;
  transition:
    translate var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--dur-2),
    transform 0.7s var(--ease-out);
}

.p-card:hover {
  translate: 0 -6px;
  border-color: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.3);
  box-shadow:
    0 34px 64px -32px rgb(6 39 31 / 0.45),
    0 0 44px -18px rgb(25 197 139 / 0.55);
}

.p-card__inner {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.p-card__media {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(80% 90% at 30% 20%, rgb(25 197 139 / 0.28), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-ink-900), var(--c-ink-950));
}

.p-card__media img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition:
    transform 1s var(--ease-out),
    opacity var(--dur-3);
}

.p-card:hover .p-card__media img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

/* scanning line crossing the product image on hover */
.p-card__scan {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, rgb(163 244 81 / 0.22) 48%, rgb(163 244 81 / 0.85) 50%, transparent 51%);
  background-size: 100% 220%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: 0 -120%;
  opacity: 0;
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.p-card:hover .p-card__scan {
  opacity: 1;
  animation: gc-scan-y 1.3s var(--ease-in-out) both;
}

.p-card__fallback {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: none;
  place-items: center;
  color: rgb(163 244 81 / 0.75);
}

.p-card__media.is-broken img {
  opacity: 0;
}

.p-card__media.is-broken .p-card__fallback {
  display: grid;
}

.p-card__badge {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 2;
  inset-block-start: 0.9rem;
  inset-inline-start: 0.9rem;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: rgb(6 39 31 / 0.85);
  color: var(--c-lime);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.25);
}

.p-card__badge .icon {
  animation: gc-twinkle 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* continuous light beam around the featured card */
.p-card__beam {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  z-index: 3;
  padding: 1.5px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: conic-gradient(
    from var(--gc-angle),
    transparent 0 70%,
    rgb(25 197 139 / 0.9) 82%,
    rgb(163 244 81 / 1) 88%,
    transparent 96%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask-composite: exclude;
  opacity: 0.85;
  animation: gc-angle 6s linear infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.p-card__body {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  padding: clamp(1.15rem, 2.2cqi, 1.6rem);
}

.p-card__title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.p-card__title a {
  background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor);
  background-size: 0 1px;
  background-position: 100% 100%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  transition: background-size var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out);
}

.p-card__title a:hover {
  background-size: 100% 1px;
}

.p-card__desc {
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  line-height: 1.95;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.p-card__desc:empty {
  display: none;
}

.p-card__footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.9rem 1rem;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--c-line-strong);
}

.p-card--featured .p-card__title {
  font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 1.1rem + 0.8vw, 1.75rem);
}

.p-card--featured .p-card__desc {
  font-size: var(--fs-base);
  -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
}

.p-card__highlights {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin-block: 0.3rem 0.4rem;
}

.p-card__highlights:empty {
  display: none;
}

.p-card__highlights li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.js .p-card__highlights li {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(14px);
  transition:
    opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out),
    transform 0.7s var(--ease-out);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 120ms + 450ms);
}

.js .is-revealed .p-card__highlights li {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

.p-card__highlights .icon {
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  padding: 2px;
  width: 1.15rem;
  height: 1.15rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-ink-950);
  color: var(--c-lime);
}

.p-card__actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem 1.1rem;
}

.p-card__cart {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  padding-block: 0.4rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--c-green-ink);
  transition: color var(--dur-2);
}

.p-card__cart:hover {
  color: var(--c-ink-950);
}

.p-card__cart .icon {
  transition: transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-spring);
}

.p-card__cart:hover .icon {
  transform: translateX(-4px) rotate(-10deg);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1023.98px) {
  .p-card--featured .p-card__inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .p-card--featured .p-card__media {
    order: 2;
    aspect-ratio: auto;
    min-height: 100%;
  }
}

/* price */
.p-card__price .price {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.1rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.p-card__price .price__now {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.p-card__price .price__amount {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.p-card--featured .p-card__price .price__amount {
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 1.2rem + 0.6vw, 1.75rem);
}

.p-card__price .price__unit,
.p-card__price .price__prefix {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.p-card__price .price__regular {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.p-card__price .price--inquiry {
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--c-green-ink);
}

/* custom solutions card (dark, not a store product — no price) */
.p-card--custom {
  --focus-ring: var(--c-lime);
  --glow-color: rgb(163 244 81 / 0.08);
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--c-ink-900), var(--c-ink-950) 70%);
  border-color: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.25);
  color: var(--c-on-dark);
}

.p-card--custom .p-card__title {
  color: var(--c-white);
}

.p-card--custom .p-card__desc {
  color: var(--c-on-dark-muted);
}

.p-card--custom .p-card__footer {
  border-top-color: var(--c-line-dark);
}

.p-card__art {
  position: relative;
  height: 7.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-line-dark);
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgb(163 244 81 / 0.1) 1px, transparent 1.3px);
  background-size: 18px 18px;
}

.p-card__art svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.p-card__art-trace {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.4);
  stroke-width: 1.3;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.p-card__art-pulse {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--c-lime);
  stroke-width: 2.2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  --pulse-len: 0.1;
  stroke-dasharray: 0.1 3;
  stroke-dashoffset: 0.1;
  animation: gc-pulse-travel 4.5s var(--ease-pulse) infinite;
}

.p-card__art-pulse--b {
  animation-delay: 1.5s;
}

.p-card__art-pulse--c {
  animation-delay: 3s;
}

.p-card__art-chip {
  fill: var(--c-ink-950);
  stroke: rgb(163 244 81 / 0.55);
  stroke-width: 1.2;
}

.p-card__art-node {
  fill: var(--c-lime);
  animation: gc-breathe 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.p-card__art-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 3rem;
  color: var(--c-lime);
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  transition: transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-spring);
}

.p-card--custom:hover .p-card__art-icon {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.12) rotate(90deg);
}

/* skeleton */
.p-card--skeleton {
  pointer-events: none;
}

.skel {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: rgb(23 43 37 / 0.07);
  border-radius: var(--r-xs);
}

.skel::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7), transparent);
  animation: gc-shimmer 1.4s linear infinite;
}

.p-card__media.skel {
  border-radius: 0;
  background: rgb(23 43 37 / 0.08);
}

.skel--chip {
  width: 6rem;
  height: 1.4rem;
}

.skel--title {
  width: 70%;
  height: 1.6rem;
}

.skel--line {
  width: 100%;
  height: 0.85rem;
}

.skel--short {
  width: 80%;
}

.skel--tiny {
  width: 55%;
}

.skel--btn {
  width: 11rem;
  height: 2.75rem;
  margin-top: auto;
}

/* notice (API unavailable / empty) */
.p-notice {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  border: 1px dashed rgb(11 68 53 / 0.3);
  background:
    radial-gradient(70% 90% at 100% 0%, rgb(25 197 139 / 0.1), transparent 60%),
    var(--c-white);
}

.p-notice__icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 3.25rem;
  height: 3.25rem;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--c-ink-950);
  color: var(--c-lime);
}

.p-notice__title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
}

.p-notice__body {
  max-width: 32rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   3. SERVICES
   ========================================================================== */

.services__decor {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgb(11 68 53 / 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(11 68 53 / 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 56px 56px;
  background-position: right top;
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 85% 8%, #000, transparent 70%);
  mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 85% 8%, #000, transparent 70%);
}

/* grid cells that light up like memory blocks */
.services__decor i {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(var(--r) * 56px + 1px);
  right: calc(var(--c) * 56px);
  width: 55px;
  height: 55px;
  background: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.1);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(25 197 139 / 0.25);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: gc-cell var(--t, 6s) ease-in-out var(--d, 0s) infinite;
}

.services__decor i:nth-child(3n) {
  background: rgb(163 244 81 / 0.16);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.4);
}

.services__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: clamp(1rem, 1.6vw, 1.5rem);
  margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
}

.services__item {
  display: flex;
}

.s-card {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  container-type: inline-size;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2.25rem);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-line);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--c-white), #f5fcf8);
  translate: 0 0;
  transition:
    translate var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--dur-2);
}

/* rotating light beam around the border while hovered */
.s-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  z-index: 3;
  padding: 1.5px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: conic-gradient(
    from var(--gc-angle),
    transparent 0 58%,
    rgb(25 197 139 / 0.9) 74%,
    rgb(163 244 81 / 1) 84%,
    transparent 94%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask-composite: exclude;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--dur-3);
  animation: gc-angle 3.8s linear infinite paused;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.s-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
  animation-play-state: running;
}

.s-card:hover {
  translate: 0 -5px;
  border-color: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.3);
  box-shadow:
    0 30px 60px -34px rgb(6 39 31 / 0.45),
    0 0 0 1px rgb(25 197 139 / 0.08);
}

.s-card__trace {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 1.5rem;
  top: -1px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(to left, var(--c-green), var(--c-lime));
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: right;
  transition: transform 0.8s var(--ease-out);
}

.s-card:hover .s-card__trace,
.services__item.is-revealed .s-card__trace {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

.services__item.is-revealed .s-card__trace {
  transition-delay: 0.5s;
}

.s-card__head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}

.s-card__icon {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 3.25rem;
  height: 3.25rem;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--c-ink-950);
  color: var(--c-lime);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.18);
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-spring),
    box-shadow var(--dur-3);
}

/* corner ticks around the icon — drawn on hover */
.s-card__icon::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -6px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px dashed rgb(25 197 139 / 0.6);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.8) rotate(-12deg);
  transition:
    opacity var(--dur-3),
    transform 0.7s var(--ease-out);
}

.s-card:hover .s-card__icon {
  transform: translateY(-3px) rotate(-5deg);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.4),
    0 12px 26px -12px rgb(25 197 139 / 0.9);
}

.s-card:hover .s-card__icon::after {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

.s-card__index {
  font-size: 2.6rem;
  font-weight: 200;
  line-height: 1;
  color: transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgb(11 68 53 / 0.28);
  transition:
    color var(--dur-3),
    -webkit-text-stroke-color var(--dur-3);
}

.s-card:hover .s-card__index {
  color: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.4);
  -webkit-text-stroke-color: transparent;
}

.s-card__title {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.s-card__desc {
  font-size: var(--fs-base);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.95;
}

.s-card__list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0.55rem 1.5rem;
  margin-block: 0.4rem 0.2rem;
  padding-top: 1.1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-line);
}

@container (min-width: 460px) {
  .s-card__list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

.s-card__list li {
  position: relative;
  padding-inline-start: 1.25rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--c-text);
  transition: color var(--dur-2);
}

/* PCB pad bullet */
.s-card__list li::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0.6em;
  width: 0.5rem;
  height: 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 2px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--c-green);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  transition:
    background-color var(--dur-2),
    box-shadow var(--dur-3),
    transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-spring);
}

/* pads light up one after another */
.s-card:hover .s-card__list li::before {
  background: var(--c-green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgb(25 197 139 / 0.7);
  transform: rotate(225deg);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 70ms);
}

.s-card__footer {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
}

@media (max-width: 767.98px) {
  .services__grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .services__decor i:nth-child(n + 4) {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   4. CAPABILITIES
   ========================================================================== */

.capabilities {
  padding-bottom: 0;
}

/* light that drifts with scroll progress, plus a slow aurora */
.capabilities__light {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -2;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      40% 55% at calc(18% + var(--p, 0.5) * 14%) calc(26% + var(--p, 0.5) * 34%),
      rgb(25 197 139 / 0.18),
      transparent 70%
    ),
    radial-gradient(45% 50% at 95% 100%, rgb(11 68 53 / 0.9), transparent 70%);
}

.capabilities__aurora {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -2;
  width: 46vmax;
  height: 46vmax;
  right: -12vmax;
  top: -14vmax;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgb(163 244 81 / 0.07), transparent 70%);
  animation: gc-aurora 24s var(--ease-in-out) infinite alternate;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.capabilities__inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem);
}

.capabilities__text {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  color: var(--c-on-dark-muted);
}

/* scroll-lit words (motion.js) */
.sw {
  opacity: clamp(0.3, calc(var(--sp, 1) * (var(--n, 1) + 6) - var(--i, 0)), 1);
  transition: opacity 0.25s linear;
}

.capabilities__list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 2.25rem;
}

.capabilities__item {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-line-dark);
  background: rgb(233 247 240 / 0.03);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--c-on-dark);
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur-2),
    background-color var(--dur-2),
    transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out);
}

/* light sweep across the item after it appears */
.capabilities__item::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 35%, rgb(163 244 81 / 0.12) 50%, transparent 65%);
  transform: translateX(110%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.capabilities__item.is-revealed::after {
  animation: gc-sweep 1.4s var(--ease-out) calc(var(--reveal-i, 0) * 120ms + 0.5s) both;
}

.capabilities__item:hover {
  border-color: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.45);
  background: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.07);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.capabilities__icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 2.4rem;
  height: 2.4rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: rgb(163 244 81 / 0.1);
  color: var(--c-lime);
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-spring),
    box-shadow var(--dur-3);
}

.capabilities__item:hover .capabilities__icon {
  transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.08);
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px -4px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.6);
}

.capabilities__visual {
  position: relative;
}

/* technology ticker */
.ticker {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  margin-top: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5.5rem);
  padding-block: clamp(1.4rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-line-dark);
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(4 28 22 / 0), rgb(4 28 22 / 0.55));
}

.ticker__row {
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 10%, #000 90%, transparent);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 10%, #000 90%, transparent);
}

.ticker__inner {
  display: flex;
  width: max-content;
  animation: gc-marquee var(--ticker-t, 46s) linear infinite;
}

.ticker__row--rtl .ticker__inner {
  animation-name: gc-marquee-rtl;
}

.ticker:hover .ticker__inner {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

.ticker__track {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2.75rem;
  padding-inline-end: 2.75rem;
}

.ticker__track li {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2.75rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.9rem + 0.5vw, 1.35rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: rgb(233 247 240 / 0.55);
  transition: color var(--dur-2);
}

.ticker__track li::after {
  content: '';
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: var(--c-green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgb(25 197 139 / 0.8);
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.ticker__track li:hover {
  color: var(--c-lime);
}

.ticker__row--mono li {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: rgb(233 247 240 / 0.38);
}

@media (max-width: 1023.98px) {
  .capabilities__inner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .capabilities__visual {
    width: min(100%, 520px);
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 559.98px) {
  .capabilities__list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .capabilities__visual {
    padding-inline: 1.75rem;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   5. ROADMAP — «در حال توسعه و برنامه‌های آینده»
   Styled as a blueprint (dashed outlines, no prices, no purchase actions)
   so nothing reads as an available product.
   ========================================================================== */

.roadmap {
  background:
    radial-gradient(55% 70% at 0% 100%, rgb(25 197 139 / 0.14), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(40% 50% at 100% 0%, rgb(163 244 81 / 0.12), transparent 70%),
    var(--c-mint-50);
}

.roadmap__blueprint {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgb(11 68 53 / 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(11 68 53 / 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(rgb(11 68 53 / 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(11 68 53 / 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size:
    96px 96px,
    96px 96px,
    24px 24px,
    24px 24px;
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to left, transparent 5%, #000 55%, #000 90%, transparent);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(to left, transparent 5%, #000 55%, #000 90%, transparent);
}

/* blueprint scanner line */
.roadmap__blueprint::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset-block: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 160px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(25 197 139 / 0.07) 80%, rgb(25 197 139 / 0.38) 99%, transparent);
  animation: gc-scan-x 9s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.roadmap__inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 6rem);
}

.roadmap__badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem 0.4rem 1rem;
  border: 1px dashed rgb(11 68 53 / 0.35);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--c-green-ink);
}

.roadmap__badge-icon {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 1.6rem;
  height: 1.6rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-ink-950);
  color: var(--c-lime);
}

/* «work in progress» — a dashed ring that keeps turning */
.roadmap__badge-icon::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -4px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px dashed rgb(25 197 139 / 0.75);
  animation: gc-spin 7s linear infinite;
}

.roadmap__title {
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.roadmap__desc {
  margin-top: 1.1rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.roadmap__note {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-block: 1.4rem 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-line);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.roadmap__note .icon {
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  color: var(--c-green-ink);
}

.roadmap__list-title {
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  padding-inline-start: 2.75rem;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.roadmap__rail {
  position: relative;
}

.roadmap__list {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

/* marching dashed trace connecting the nodes */
.roadmap__list::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: calc(0.75rem - 1px);
  top: 1.5rem;
  bottom: 1.5rem;
  width: 2px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(25 197 139 / 0.55) 0 7px, transparent 7px 13px);
  background-size: 2px 13px;
  animation: gc-march 0.9s linear infinite;
}

/* a signal travelling down the planned items */
.roadmap__signal {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 2;
  inset-inline-start: calc(0.75rem - 4px);
  top: 1.5rem;
  bottom: 1.5rem;
  width: 8px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.roadmap__signal i {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  animation: gc-signal 5.5s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.roadmap__signal i::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: -4px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-lime);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.2), 0 0 14px 2px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.8);
}

.roadmap__item {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.roadmap__node {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 1.5rem;
  height: 1.5rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-green);
  background: var(--c-mint-50);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgb(25 197 139 / 0.1);
}

.roadmap__node::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 4px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c-green);
  opacity: 0.35;
}

.roadmap__node::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -2px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgb(25 197 139 / 0.7);
  opacity: 0;
}

.roadmap__item.is-revealed .roadmap__node::before {
  animation: gc-ping 1.4s var(--ease-out) calc(var(--reveal-i, 0) * 90ms + 0.35s) 2;
}

.roadmap__card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.15rem;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px dashed rgb(11 68 53 / 0.28);
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8);
  translate: 0 0;
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur-2),
    translate var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--dur-3);
}

.roadmap__card:hover {
  translate: -5px 0;
  border-color: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.6);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -24px rgb(6 39 31 / 0.4);
}

.roadmap__icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 2.9rem;
  height: 2.9rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px dashed rgb(25 197 139 / 0.55);
  color: var(--c-green-ink);
  background: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.06);
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-spring),
    background-color var(--dur-2);
}

.roadmap__card:hover .roadmap__icon {
  transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.05);
  background: rgb(25 197 139 / 0.12);
}

.roadmap__text {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.1rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.roadmap__index {
  font-size: var(--fs-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}

.roadmap__name {
  font-size: var(--fs-base);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--c-text);
}

.roadmap__status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  margin-inline-start: auto;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  border-radius: var(--r-xs);
  background: rgb(23 43 37 / 0.06);
  font-size: var(--fs-2xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.roadmap__status::before {
  content: '';
  width: 0.4rem;
  height: 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--c-green);
  animation: gc-breathe 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@media (max-width: 1023.98px) {
  .roadmap__inner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 479.98px) {
  .roadmap__status {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   6. GILAN GUIDE
   ========================================================================== */

.guide {
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--c-white), var(--c-white) 55%, rgb(240 251 246 / 0.7)),
    var(--c-white);
}

.guide__head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1.5rem 3rem;
}

.guide__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  grid-template-rows: repeat(2, clamp(15rem, 20vw, 17.5rem));
  gap: clamp(0.85rem, 1.4vw, 1.25rem);
  margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
}

.guide__tile {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
}

.guide__tile--attractions {
  grid-column: span 2;
  grid-row: span 2;
}

.guide__tile--cafes {
  grid-column: span 2;
}

.g-tile {
  --focus-ring: var(--c-lime);
  --glow-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14);
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  color: var(--c-white);
  background:
    radial-gradient(70% 80% at 30% 20%, rgb(25 197 139 / 0.35), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(140deg, var(--c-ink-900), var(--c-ink-950));
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out),
    transform 0.7s var(--ease-out);
}

.g-tile__img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -2;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  /* gentle parallax inside the frame (--p from motion.js) */
  transform: translate3d(0, calc((var(--p, 0.5) - 0.5) * -9%), 0);
  scale: 1.16;
  transition: scale 1.1s var(--ease-out);
}

.js .guide__tile:not(.is-revealed) .g-tile__img {
  scale: 1.32;
}

.js .guide__tile.is-revealed .g-tile__img {
  transition: scale 1.8s var(--ease-out);
}

.js .guide__tile.is-revealed .g-tile:hover .g-tile__img,
.g-tile:hover .g-tile__img {
  scale: 1.22;
  transition: scale 1.1s var(--ease-out);
}

.g-tile__img.is-broken {
  display: none;
}

.g-tile__shade {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background:
    linear-gradient(to top, rgb(4 28 22 / 0.92) 0%, rgb(4 28 22 / 0.55) 38%, rgb(4 28 22 / 0.05) 70%),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(4 28 22 / 0.35), transparent 30%);
  transition: opacity var(--dur-3);
}

/* lime frame + glare on hover */
.g-tile__frame {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  border-radius: inherit;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12);
  transition: box-shadow var(--dur-3);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.g-tile:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 34px 64px -30px rgb(6 39 31 / 0.6);
}

/* wipe-in reveal (right → left), staggered by the parent's --reveal-i */
.js .guide__tile .g-tile {
  clip-path: inset(0 0 0 100% round var(--r-lg));
  transition:
    clip-path 1.25s var(--ease-in-out) calc(var(--reveal-i, 0) * 130ms),
    box-shadow var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out),
    transform 0.7s var(--ease-out);
}

.js .guide__tile.is-revealed .g-tile {
  clip-path: inset(-90px round var(--r-lg));
}

.js .guide__tile .g-tile.is-tilting {
  transition:
    clip-path 1.25s var(--ease-in-out),
    box-shadow var(--dur-3) var(--ease-out),
    transform 0.12s linear;
}

.g-tile:hover .g-tile__frame {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.6),
    inset 0 0 44px -10px rgb(163 244 81 / 0.3);
}

.g-tile__top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 0;
}

.g-tile__index {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: var(--r-xs);
  background: rgb(4 28 22 / 0.55);
  color: rgb(233 247 240 / 0.85);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}

.g-tile__arrow {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 2.6rem;
  height: 2.6rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14);
  border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  transition:
    background-color var(--dur-2),
    color var(--dur-2),
    transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-spring);
}

.g-tile:hover .g-tile__arrow {
  background: var(--c-lime);
  border-color: var(--c-lime);
  color: var(--c-ink-950);
  transform: rotate(-12deg) scale(1.08);

/* ==========================================================================
   Motion system
   - Animates transform / opacity / clip-path and SVG dash offsets only,
     so nothing causes layout shifts.
   - Separate properties never fight: reveals use `transform` on wrappers,
     parallax uses `translate`, hover lifts use `translate`, tilt uses
     `transform` on the card itself.
   - Scroll reveals run once (assets/js/motion.js → reveal).
   - Continuous animations pause while their section is off-screen
     (`.is-offscreen`, set by motion.js → visibility).
   - prefers-reduced-motion: everything becomes static (bottom of file).
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Scroll reveal variants  ([data-reveal="up|fade|scale|start|end|clip"])
   [data-stagger] on a parent numbers its revealing children automatically.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.js [data-reveal] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, 30px, 0);
  transition:
    opacity 0.85s var(--ease-out),
    transform 1s var(--ease-out);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--reveal-i, 0) * var(--stagger));
}

.js [data-reveal='fade'] {
  transform: none;
}

.js [data-reveal='scale'] {
  transform: scale(0.94);
}

/* «start» enters from the right (reading start in RTL), «end» from the left */
.js [data-reveal='start'] {
  transform: translate3d(48px, 0, 0);
}

.js [data-reveal='end'] {
  transform: translate3d(-48px, 0, 0);
}

/* «clip»: the wrapper stays put and is what gets observed; its child is
   wiped in (see .g-tile in sections.css). A clip-path on the observed
   element itself would hide it from IntersectionObserver in Chrome. */
.js [data-reveal='clip'] {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

.js [data-reveal].is-revealed {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

/* the inline safety net in index.html adds .reveal-fallback if scripts fail */
.reveal-fallback [data-reveal],
.reveal-fallback [data-reveal='clip'] > * {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  transform: none !important;
  clip-path: none !important;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Split headings ([data-split]) — words rise out of a mask one by one.
   The accent phrase stays one unit so its gradient is preserved.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* a split heading reveals word by word, so the heading itself doesn't fade */
.js [data-split][data-reveal] {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

/* hidden for the instant between first paint and the split (no flash) */
.js [data-split]:not(.is-split) {
  opacity: 0;
}

.reveal-fallback [data-split] {
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

.reveal-fallback .w__i {
  transform: none !important;
}

.w {
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: top;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding-bottom: 0.26em;
  margin-bottom: -0.26em;
}

.w__i {
  display: inline-block;
  transform: translate3d(0, 130%, 0);
  transition: transform 1.05s var(--ease-out);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--wi, 0) * 60ms + var(--split-delay, 0ms));
}

.is-revealed .w__i,
.is-split-in .w__i {
  transform: none;
}

/* once played, drop the masks so descenders and dots are never clipped */
.is-split-done .w {
  overflow: visible;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Section heading seam (see components.css → .sh__seam)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.js .sh__seam {
  transform: scaleY(0);
  transition: transform 0.8s var(--ease-out);
}

.js .sh__node::before {
  transform: scale(0);
  transition: transform 0.5s var(--ease-spring) 0.55s;
}

.js .sh__node::after {
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: transform 0.7s var(--ease-out) 0.75s;
}

.js .is-revealed .sh__seam,
.js .is-revealed .sh__node::before,
.js .is-revealed .sh__node::after,
.reveal-fallback .sh__seam,
.reveal-fallback .sh__node::before,
.reveal-fallback .sh__node::after {
  transform: none;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Keyframes
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

@keyframes gc-fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes gc-fade-slide-up {
  from {
    opacity: 0;

  }

    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;

  }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Pause continuous animations inside off-screen sections
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.is-offscreen *,
.is-offscreen *::before,
.is-offscreen *::after {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Reduced motion — fully static: no animations, no transitions, no
   parallax; everything shown in its final state.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation: none !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    transition-delay: 0s !important;
  }

  .js [data-reveal] {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }

  .js .guide__tile .g-tile {
    clip-path: none;
  }

  .js [data-split] {
    opacity: 1 !important;
  }

  .w__i,
  .js .sh__seam,
  .js .sh__node::before,
  .js .sh__node::after {
    transform: none;
  }

  .js .hv__lines li {
    clip-path: none;
  }

  .js .hv__msg:first-child {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .js .cf__trace--load,
  .js .cf__trace--reveal,
  .js .hv__wire,
  .js .logo__trace {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  }

  .cf--scroll,
  .cc {
    --draw: 1;
    --tags: 1;
  }

  .cf__pulses,
  .hv__pulses,
  .cc__pulses,
  .cf__arrivals,
  .hv__arrivals,
  .cc__arrivals,
  .hero__particles,
  .cta-panel__particles,
  .roadmap__signal,
  .benefits__beam,
  .cursor-aura,
  .p-card__scan,
  .services__decor i,
  .roadmap__blueprint::after {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .hero,
  .hero__content,
  .hero__visual,
  .hv,
  .hv__layer,
  .cf__svg,
  .g-tile__img {
    translate: none !important;
    scale: none !important;
  }

  .hero__content {
    opacity: 1 !important;
  }

  .hv,
  .cf--parallax .cf__svg,
  .g-tile__img {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .cf--flip .cf__svg {
    scale: -1 1 !important;
  }

  .process__packet {
    display: none;
  }

  .sw {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
